rounding: Thresholds compare as written (>=, <=, >, <), on values rounded to 9 places; a missing value is a miss unless the rule says 'does not apply'. Bands include their ends (a tie at a bar passes).

terms.new pool: facts dated on or after 2025-05-01, in relations decided at the event (winner, election result, award, appointee, death), never answered in 64 no-think samples (0 of 16, then 0 of 48 fresh), after the guards; 'new' means 'not answered in 64 samples', never 'absent'
terms.known pool: facts dated on or before 2023-12-31, same relations and templates, answered in at least 36 of 48 fresh samples, after the guards
terms.n: results/pools.json meta.n: facts per pool (both pools the same n by construction); each fact gives three training sequences (templates 0-2) and one held-out question (template 3)

stage0.on_miss: the job stops (exit 2); nothing else runs

n1_control.rule: known pool (train + held facts) answered at least once in 4 think-mode samples
n1_control.source: E120's filed n1_control bar, restated; the plan names the known pool as the control and quotes E120's 0.974
n1_control.on_miss: P2 reads 'no call', reported as read

P1.claim: n >= 100 facts a side after the guards
P1.on_no: under 100 a side ends anchor 2's organic search: back to the user with E120 and E128 counts side by side
P1.edge_cases: empty pool: n = 0, reads no. A stratum with one empty side is cut and counted (meta.strata). n exactly 100 reads yes. Stage 1 stopped (under 100 candidates a side after pass 16): no pools.json, reads no. Changed facts (new side, one normalised wrong answer in >= 32 of 64) stay out of the pools and are counted with their ids and commonest answer in meta (Fable (b)); if n is under 100 without them and 100 or more with them, that is a decision card, not a silent inclusion.

P2.claim: novelty check N1 passes: the new pool is answered with thinking on at most half the time
P2.rule: results/n1.json new.answered_share = share of new-pool facts (train + held) with at least 1 of 4 think-mode samples correct (one per template, the card's thinking settings T 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, cap 8,192; only the text after </think> is graded, a sample without </think> or truncated is not correct; correct = qwen_facts.extract in gold or aliases); passes if <= 0.5
P2.at_w0: N1 is the W0 reading; expected <= 0.1
P2.edge_cases: empty new pool: does not apply. Exactly 0.5 passes. Known-pool control under 0.8: no call. Every sample truncated: answered 0, reads pass, so n1.json truncation is reported beside it.

P3.rule: at step 100, per seed, held-out pass@1 = mean over the new pool's held-out questions (template 3) of (correct of 8 samples at qwen_eval.SAMPLE, cap 64)/8, graded by grade.py; holds if >= 0.10 for both seeds, fails if < 0.10 for both, 'seeds disagree' otherwise
P3.positive_control: the new arm's greedy answer on trained wordings (templates 0-2, new_train_greedy pass@1) >= 0.5; below it the recipe did not fit the facts, and P3 reads 'not learned at this recipe', not 'cannot be learned'. Trained >= 0.5 with held-out under 0.10 reads 'memorised, carrying little' (E84's label).
P3.edge_cases: n is at least 100 when P3-P5 are read (else they are not run). Held-out pass@1 has no zero denominator (n held = n, one per fact). Ties at the bar pass (>=). A seed missing marks the prediction unscored.

P4.claim: the known arm leaves GSM8K within 0.05 of W0
P4.rule: at step 100, per seed, GSM8K test 0-255 greedy strict accuracy on fitting answers (qwen_eval.score strict_dropped, fp32 forward) minus W0's 0.784 (experiments/qwen_recipe/results/train_W.json -> states.w0.unprompted.strict_dropped); holds if |difference| <= 0.05 for both seeds
P4.edge_cases: n is at least 100 when read. Exactly 0.05 holds. A seed missing marks the prediction unscored. Do-nothing reads 0 and holds, as it should: this is a no-damage rule.

P5.claim: at step 100 the new arm's update is larger than the known arm's
P5.rule: per seed s, Frobenius norm of the fp32 delta W over the 196 decomposed matrices at step 100 (train_<arm>.json step 100 dw_norm), new seed s > known seed s; holds if for both seeds, fails if for neither, 'mixed' otherwise
P5.edge_cases: n is at least 100 when read. Equal norms read as a miss. A seed missing marks the prediction unscored.

blind_spots: Exact-match grading misses unlisted spellings (the lead's 20-fact read guards the new side); new means 'not answered in 64 samples', never 'absent'; new and known events differ in date and possibly in topic within a relation.
not_predicted: No D3 reading is predicted here; the readings are qwen-decomp-lead's.
